stem.text: Sulfur dioxide and oxygen react to form sulfur trioxide. The reaction is reversible.

The reaction is allowed to reach equilibrium at $700\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. The partial pressure of $\text{O}_2\text{(g)}$ is $375\ \text{kPa}$ and the partial pressure of $\text{SO}_3\text{(g)}$ is $20.3\ \text{kPa}$.
What is the partial pressure of $\text{SO}_2\text{(g)}$?
